news.title: Oil prices rise to 6-week high after Iran and U.S. trade blows, Saudi Aramco facilities reportedly hit
news.description: Renewed attacks between the adversaries in the Iran war pushed oil prices up on Monday.

news.title: Trump says Bombardier can't sell in U.S. unless Canada aerospace giant builds there
news.description: Trump's announcement comes on the eve of Canadian retaliatory tariffs set to take effect Tuesday on $20 billion of U.S. goods.

news.title: Trump says he's made 'Hundreds of Billions of Dollars on Stocks' for the U.S., in stream of AI posts
news.description: U.S. President Donald Trump posted a stream of AI-generated images and a series of sweeping and unverified claims on Truth Social on Sunday
